newsitem.title: USA: Spartech says purchases helped Q4 net rise.
newsitem.headline: Spartech says purchases helped Q4 net rise.

text.p: Spartech Corp said Tuesday two acquisitions and new products helped sales and earnings hit record levels in the fourth quarter of 1996.
Sales in the three months to November 2 reached $104 million, up from $86 million in the fourth quarter of 1995. Net income was $4.7 million, up from $3.6 million in the same period in 1995.

Spartech's recent purchase of Hamelin Group's Extrusion, Color and Molding divisions contributed $3.9 million to its sales and $400,000 to operating earnings in the period, said president and chief executive officer Bradley Buechler.
Spartech makes thermoplastic materials and compounds.
